description: Java source code defining the 'Diagnosis' entity class for managing diagnosis data in an OpenMRS (Open Medical Record System) project. The class includes fields, constructors, getters, setters, and annotations for persistence mapping, representing diagnoses linked to encounters, patients, conditions, and attributes.
